Exhibit 99.1
Apple reports third quarter results
Quarterly revenue of $94.0 billion, up 10 percent year over year
Diluted earnings per share of $1.57, up 12 percent year over year
CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA, July 30, 2026. The Company today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 third quarter ended June 27, 2026. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $94.0 billion, up 10 percent year over year, and quarterly diluted earnings per share of $1.57, up 12 percent year over year. Services revenue reached a June quarter record of $27.4 billion, and the installed base of active devices reached a new all-time high across every product category and geographic segment.
"Our June quarter results reflect strong demand for the latest hardware models together with double-digit growth in Services, and the installed base of active devices set a new record," said the Company's chief executive officer. "We remain focused on delivering products that combine hardware, software, and services in ways that matter to customers, and the work our teams are doing across the product roadmap gives us confidence heading into the September quarter."
"We generated operating cash flow of $27.9 billion during the quarter and returned $29.0 billion to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases," said the Company's chief financial officer. "Gross margin was 46.5 percent, within the range we provided in April, and we ended the quarter with $133.0 billion in cash and marketable securities against $101.7 billion of total debt."
The Company's board of directors has declared a cash dividend of $0.26 per share of the Company's common stock. The dividend is payable on August 13, 2026 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on August 10, 2026.
The Company will provide live streaming of its fiscal 2026 third quarter financial results conference call beginning at 2:00 p.m. PT on July 30, 2026. The webcast will be available for replay for approximately two weeks thereafter.

These statements involve risks and uncertainties, and actual results may differ materially. Risks and uncertainties include, without limitation, the effect of global and regional economic conditions on the Company's business, including effects on purchasing decisions by consumers and businesses; risks related to the Company's ability to manage the frequency and timing of product introductions and transitions; the effect that shifts in the mix of products and services and in the geographic, currency, or channel mix could have on the Company's gross margin; the Company's dependency on the performance of distributors of the Company's products; the effect of tariffs, trade restrictions, and other government actions on the Company's supply chain and cost of goods; risks related to the Company's reliance on single-source suppliers and manufacturing partners; the potential impact of investigations, claims, and litigation, including antitrust and digital-market regulation; and the Company's ability to attract and retain key personnel. More information on these risks and other potential factors that could affect the Company's financial results is included in the Company's filings with the SEC, including in the "Risk Factors" and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" sections of the Company's most recently filed periodic reports on Form 10-K and Form 10-Q and subsequent filings. The Company assumes no obligation to update any forward-looking statements, which speak only as of the date they are made.
About the Company
The Company designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. The Company's fiscal year is the 52- or 53-week period that ends on the last Saturday of September.
